blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — A body was found washed ashore in Tandag City, Surigao del Sur on Wednesday noon. The body was found at 12:30 p.m. in Barangay Rosario amid the search operations for a 14-year-old boy who was swept by huge waves in the adjacent coastal town of Tago on Tuesday afternoon, which was later halted due to dangerous waves and strong underwater currents. It was not yet clear if the body found washed ashore was that of the missing boy.
